content: The arrow of the master's word struck my heart; it pierced through illusion and awakened the sleeping soul.
author: Kabir
explanation: A true teaching does not soothe the ego; it pierces straight through defensive illusions with surgical precision, shattering ignorance and awakening pure consciousness.
practicalInsight: When an authentic truth makes you feel uncomfortable today, lean in and let it dismantle your ignorance rather than resisting.
reflectionPrompt: What uncomfortable truth am I avoiding that possesses the power to set me free?
